packages.doc: Explicit source-owned exposure of a performed behavior to an operator. Allocation alone does not authorize invocation. The actual caller and target are fixed by native bindings on each enabled occurrence. Input is a schema reference, refined to a model-owned item definition; it is not a stored request and has no binding to mutable case facts.

A conversational builder starts alone and proposes candidate capabilities. The host waits for human admission until an approved configuration change assigns admission authority. A reviewer is added only by an approved change. PAE is the assembled behavior of these parts. It introduces no phantom runtime control parts. Runtime evidence remains in the host store. The host interprets the native bounded action-flow subset and the configured policy and mandates; definitions alone do not establish an admitted capability or execution.

APE 5.1 - Context Separation. Bounded decision-context policy and evidence access separate the current decision context from durable execution evidence. A concrete ConversationSystem may own one explicit policy. Definitions alone neither change the context nor grant access to evidence. ReadContextEvidence requires a separately admitted BehaviorAccess and remains confined to the receiving operator's own conversation.

APE 1.3 - Conversational Case Management. Native description of a bounded conversational case. The TypeScript host retains the session, reads its state, controls effects and presents outcomes to the same builder. The host interprets the supported native action occurrences, successions and decision guards; named action definitions select implemented primitive mechanisms. This is a bounded executable subset, not a complete SysML interpreter. Waiting suspends this open case; it is not closure. No verified closure or accepted-handoff mechanism exists in this slice.
Neutral structural primitives. These definitions carry values and communication contracts; they do not create runtime control actors.

Policy consumed from the selected native model by the host's bounded action-flow interpreter. Native successions and guards determine order; named action definitions select the standalone primitive-handler registry of implemented mechanisms. Unknown primitives fail closed. This package does not claim support for the complete SysML execution language. Revision permissions permit proposals subject to approved configuration changes. They do not immediately widen the active mandate or network scope.

Candidate promotion lifecycle specified from SystemRuntime.build, stage and initialize in src/application/system-runtime.ts. The host owns execution and retained status; this state machine is a native design description, not proof that a transition occurred in a live session.

APE 5.2 - Governed Memory Promotion. Bounded local-note mechanisms promote observations to reusable guidance through an exact revision and digest decision. Capturing or reading a candidate does not admit it. A policy belongs directly to one ConversationSystem and its builder owns the local memory. Each action additionally requires an exact native BehaviorAccess; this declaration alone grants no permission.

APE 4.1 Operator Identity & Mandate: bounded authority to grant and redelegate source-editing rights. Proposals remain subject to 2.1 Proposal–Admission–Execution Separation. This declaration configures permissions; it is not execution evidence.

APE 4.1 Operator Identity & Mandate: bounded source-editing delegation. Proposals remain subject to 2.1 Proposal–Admission–Execution Separation. This declaration configures permissions; it is not execution evidence.

APE 2.1 - Proposal–Admission–Execution Separation, with APE 2.2 - Fail-Closed Admission. Bounded PAE assembly for candidate promotion. PAE abbreviates proposal, admission and execution. Proposing, judging and admitting are separate actions allocated to the concrete system's existing parts. The assembly is behavior, not an extra runtime part. Here execution means activating the admitted candidate; a later invocation of that capability is a separate operation. Related use cases: Task Automation and Change Control. These are compositions, not patterns 3.1 Decision-to-Effect Traceability or 3.2 Instance-Bound Controls. This bounded slice does not establish full composition conformance, authenticated approval, rollback or closure. Historical source identity 7: composition-7-agent-built-deterministic-capability.mjs. Historical source identity 8: composition-8-sandboxed-candidate-construction-with-controlled-promotion.mjs. These filenames identify sources, not the public titles or chapter numbers.

Bounded design requirements from SystemRuntime.build and runTurn in src/application/system-runtime.ts. Satisfaction links assign design responsibilities; they are neither test results nor execution evidence. Runtime behavior and exact checks are governed by that host source.

Skills are versioned local instructions belonging to decision context. Installing text neither executes it nor activates its instructions. Explicit native exposures separately grant installation, listing, loading and unloading; this policy alone grants none of those operations. Classic executable tools retain their independent catalog and lifecycle.
Technical publication facts supplied by the allocated catalog reader. Verification criteria belong to the caller's WorkResultContract.

APE 3.4: source-owned expected values, observed state type and native constraint. Work and observation remain separately admitted actions. The bounded runtime evaluates scalar items and native constraints; this library does not claim support for native verification-case execution.

APE 3.6 - Budget-Bounded Loop. Bounded realization for cumulative agent invocations in one durable operator dossier; not tokens or cost. Definitions alone grant no permission and select no budget. Instantiate exactly one policy directly inside the concrete ConversationSystem. Only an admitted source revision can change this policy. Runtime counters live outside the model and cannot be written by the agent.

Generic technical entries into modeled operator runtimes and their artifact catalogs. A performed occurrence must be allocated to the exact operator or catalog in its owning ConversationSystem. BehaviorAccess separately fixes every authorized caller. These definitions grant no admission, network scope or access to another conversation.

fieldSources.id: Session.elementId (UUIDv5, stable for the same qualified name); steps/ports/states are `<card id>#<SysML element id>`
fieldSources.element: Session.elementId of the SysML element behind the item
fieldSources.keyword: Session.metaclass mapped through the closed SysML keyword table
fieldSources.title: derived(e,'name'); tool: value of the library attribute CapabilityContract::kind; access: BehaviorAccess::name (found by redefinition root)
fieldSources.summary: firstSentence(Session.docs(e)); else a designated library attribute (access description, mandate scope, contract criteria); else docs of the typing definition
fieldSources.file:line:col: Session.declarationSite (fallback memberExtent) + Session.units() byte offset to line
fieldSources.ports: PortUsage in ownedFeature + inheritedFeature; type via typings (ConjugatedPortDefinition -> originalPortDefinition)
fieldSources.steps: members of the typing ActionDefinition: SuccessionAsUsage(sourceFeature,targetFeature), TransitionUsage(source,target,guardExpression), DecisionNode/MergeNode/ForkNode/JoinNode
fieldSources.guard: text rebuilt from the guard expression tree (OperatorExpression.operator, FeatureChainExpression, FeatureReferenceExpression, Literal*), never from source text
fieldSources.track: StateUsage/TransitionUsage among ownedFeature+inheritedFeature of the StateDefinition; entryAction + succession for the initial state; trigger = type of accept payload
fieldSources.values: AttributeUsage members evaluated (Session.evaluate), library feature found by redefinitionRoot

rule.select: root PartUsage (owned by a package) whose subtree contains a PartUsage conforming to one of the operator anchors
rule.panels: child PartUsage among ownedFeature + inheritedFeature, in source order; kept when it is an operator, typed, or contains a kept part; parts conforming to Rules / Can do anchors live in their own column
rule.ports: PortUsage among ownedFeature + inheritedFeature of the part; conjugated port types show their original definition
